subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Analisar a estrutura e funcionamento dos hiperlinks em textos noticiosos publicados na Web e vislumbrar possibilidades de uma escrita hipertextual.

components.description_pt: Identificar a estrutura e função de hiperlinks em textos de notícia baseados na web
components.description_en: Identify the structure and function of hyperlinks in web-based news texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify common text features such as headings, sidebars, and hyperlinks in informational texts

components.description_pt: Analisar como hiperlinks expandem ou conectam significado dentro de um texto de notícia digital
components.description_en: Analyze how hyperlinks expand or connect meaning within a digital news text
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a text's structure contributes to its overall meaning

components.description_pt: Explorar possibilidades de escrita hipertextual conectando conteúdo por meio de links
components.description_en: Explore possibilities of hypertextual writing by connecting content through links
components.cc_component_description: Explore a variety of digital tools available for producing writing with adult guidance

cc_matches.description: Use text features and search tools (e.g., key words, sidebars, hyperlinks) to locate information relevant to a given topic efficiently.
With guidance and support from adults, explore a variety of digital tools to produce and publish writing, including in collaboration with peers.
Compare and contrast the structure of two or more texts and analyze how the differing structure of each text contributes to its meaning and style.
